name: Hindustan Petroleum Corporation Ltd.
business_summary: Marketing-heavy oil PSU: ~50 MMT annual product sales (~22% market share, ~22,000 retail outlets), refining ~24 MMTPA (Mumbai 9.5, Visakh 15 MMTPA after expansion, model knowledge), 48.99% of HPCL-Mittal Energy (Bathinda) and the Barmer HPCL Rajasthan Refinery (HRRL, 9 MMTPA) under commissioning. ONGC owns 54.9% (promoter). Retail prices are quasi-administered, so HPCL is more exposed to crude-driven under-recoveries than IOC. Q1 FY27 loss Rs 12.3k cr, then Q2 profit Rs 3.6k cr; Visakh refinery fire on 2 Nov.

exposures.mechanism: Marketing-heavy OMC (sales ~50 MMT vs refining 24 MMT). Calibration: operating profit swung from Rs 9.2k cr (Mar-26) to -Rs 16.1k cr (Jun-26) with Brent up ~40-50% and frozen pump prices, i.e. ~Rs -25k cr per quarter per +45%, or ~Rs -5.5k cr per quarter per +10% if sustained, offset ~25% by refining gain. Market looks through to temporary losses plus compensation/price hikes: a one-quarter-equivalent loss Rs ~2.5k cr per +10% = 3% of market cap Rs 81k cr, ... pack elasticity -2.73 (t -4.6) agrees; w = -3.0.

evidence.note: Q2 FY27 swing to profit Rs3,483 cr from Rs11,526 cr loss in Q1 (Zee Business, Reuters, NDTV Profit)

exposures.mechanism: GRM +$2 on 24 MMT (176m bbl) + 48.99% of HMEL 11.3 MMT (40m bbl) = 216m bbl x $2 = $430m = Rs 4.1k cr = ~20% of normalised EBITDA Rs 20k cr x EV/MCap 1.8 x persistence 0.3 => +10.8; haircut 50% (tax, levies, Vizag outage) => +5.0. Pack -2.28 (t -4.1) reflects the heating-oil proxy's crude co-movement, which is already in the Brent edge.

evidence.note: Q2 FY27 swing to profit Rs3,483 cr from Rs11,526 cr loss in Q1 (Zee Business, Reuters, NDTV Profit)

exposures.mechanism: +1 = Rs2/litre excise rise: ~45bn L petrol+diesel x Rs2 = Rs 9k cr = 45% of normalised EBITDA if absorbed; absorb 20% x 45% x 1.8 x 0.15 => -2.4; excise usually timed to crude falls (neutral) => -1.5.

evidence.note: OMCs seek Rs75,000 cr; ICRA Rs530 cr/day losses

exposures.mechanism: Exports ~2-3 MMT; small. Rs 6/L x 3 MMT = Rs 2.2k cr x 20%... ~11% of EBITDA x 1.8 x 0.1 => -0.4.

INR weaker raises rupee crude bill (all USD) while pump prices frozen: 3% on Rs 3.2 lakh cr crude bill = Rs 9.6k cr gross, ~60% recovered => -Rs 3.8k cr = -19% EBITDA x 1.8 x persistence 0.25 => -8.6 theoretical; market evidence weaker (pack -1.74 for IOC, HPCL beta high). Shrink => -2.2.
Debt ~Rs 67k cr (interest Rs 1,259 cr in Sep-26 quarter), 40% floating: 25bp = Rs 67 cr = 1.3% of normalised PBT; discount-rate effect adds => -0.8.
Fuel volumes +0.8pp per +1pp GDP: marketing margin on 50 MMT x +0.8% => EBITDA +1.2% x 1.8 => +1.0 (structural 1.0 minus subsidy drag).

Escalation => Brent +12%: -3.6 via Brent edge, plus supply-security premium on ~60% Middle East crude and freight/insurance; Visakh refinery processes West Asian grades. Stock -3.3% over 3m, -21% over 12m.

evidence.note: OMCs seek Rs75,000 cr; ICRA Rs530 cr/day losses

exposures.mechanism: HPCL imports some Russian crude (Mittal/ HMEL joint volumes, model knowledge): $2.5 discount on ~40m bbl = $100m = Rs 0.95k cr = ~5% of EBITDA x 1.8 x 0.3 => +1.4. US tariff risk caps the benefit.
LNG used in fuel mix and hydrogen at Mumbai/ Visakh; pack -0.81 (t -1.7); ~-1.5% EBITDA x 1.8 x 0.2 => -0.5.

+1 = Rs 25k cr compensation; HPCL share ~22% = Rs 5.5k cr pre-tax, Rs 4.1k cr post-tax = 5.1% of market cap Rs 81k cr x 0.9 probability of cash form => +4.5. Centre will decide in 2027 (Moneycontrol 7 Sep).
